cycle_and_phase_audit.interpretation: The phase-safe driver removes its old unconditional negedge bubble, but the replay falls behind the M53 target timeline almost immediately. The final RTL makespan is 8.306% longer than the transaction model and nearly every group is late; this is a cycle-model discrepancy, not speedup evidence.

sva_cover_audit.share_cover_partition_warning: K2 full/partial/no-share sums to cp_k2, but K3 and K4 share covers do not form exhaustive partitions; their residual request counts are 139904 and 2514920 respectively.

architecture_and_environment_audit.wrapper_role: thin synthesizable telemetry wrapper around the frozen M54 core
architecture_and_environment_audit.schedule_source: testbench reads the offline frozen binary stream and sequentially drives descriptors and launches

admitted: exact-SHA full, non-sampled S00 VCS functional replay of the frozen offline schedule
2592000 ordered output tags/counts and signed19x96 all-plus-one accumulator checks
7011032 request/response FIFO tag-conservation events, phase counters and listed SVA covers
8791654 standalone wrapper/core replay cycles under latency-1, always-ready request/output conditions
not_admitted: an online scheduling policy or scheduling hardware in the M57 wrapper
the 8117384 M53 model cycles as RTL or system cycles

P1.finding: The RTL explicitly says it contains no scheduler. It only wraps M54 with telemetry; the testbench reads a frozen offline stream, waits against target cycles and drives descriptor/launch transactions.
P1.impact: M57 cannot be presented as online scheduling hardware or as closing schedule-generation cost.
P1.minimal_fix: Implement a synthesizable descriptor/group scheduler and address generator, feed it ordered trace metadata rather than precomputed launches, and prove transaction equivalence to the frozen stream.

P1.finding: The terminal evidence is one full sample, S00. It does not replay the other nine frozen samples or compose non-M53 operators and memory into full-network cycles.
P1.impact: The result cannot establish distribution robustness or an end-to-end accelerator speedup.
P1.minimal_fix: Run and seal all ten samples with per-sample identities, conservation, latency distributions and a frozen whole-network/Amdahl denominator.

P1.finding: RTL takes 8791654 cycles versus 8117384 model cycles, an extra 674270 or 8.306%. 839443 of 839456 groups are late, accumulated lateness is 346984961248 cycles, and launch_valid waits 5359724 cycles.
P1.impact: The M53 target schedule is not realizable by this replay as written; model cycles cannot be promoted to RTL/system cycles or performance advantage.
P1.minimal_fix: Reconcile every source of the 674270-cycle gap, publish per-group launch delay and critical queue reason, then regenerate an executable cycle model that exactly predicts RTL or conservatively bounds it.

P1.finding: The testbench hardwires weight_request_ready and output_ready high, uses response latency 1 and injects no response backpressure. Request/response/output stall covers are zero; max context/meta/complete occupancies are only 8/1/7 of 16/16/16.
P1.impact: The queue sizing, stall stability, sustained memory bandwidth and cycle result are not demonstrated under a realizable SRAM/DRAM subsystem.
P1.minimal_fix: Replay a frozen latency/backpressure matrix including address-timed banks, burst conflicts and long responses; hit all queue-capacity and simultaneous pop/push boundaries without mismatch/deadlock.

P1.finding: There is no M57-integrated DC/STA/Formality, memory macro/CACTI, SAIF/PTPX, accuracy or equal-resource baseline evidence.
P1.impact: Standalone VCS cycles do not support DATE-level throughput, area or energy claims.
P1.minimal_fix: After scheduler/memory cycle closure, run exact-SHA Synopsys implementation and power flows and compare fixed/local-only, M53 oracle, Prosperity and Phi-like adapters under the same process, clock, memory and accuracy contract.

P2.finding: The contract pins simv, wrapper, testbench, SVA and filelist but not the M54 core RTL source that the filelist compiles. The executable is exact, but source-level reproduction cannot prove the current M54 bytes generated it.
P2.minimal_fix: Add the M54 core RTL SHA and a frozen source snapshot to the contract and prelaunch manifest.

P2.finding: The compact event ledger records request/response/output activity, not command/launch accept or launch stall/target information. Its replayer trusts END for fusion groups, phase counts, launch stalls and accumulated lateness.
P2.minimal_fix: Add compact command/launch/target/deadline event bits so an independent replay derives phase and lateness counters rather than accepting END totals.

P2.finding: prelaunch_artificial_bubbles is initialized to zero and never incremented. Requiring it to remain zero is not a dynamic proof; the direct/aligned phase counters provide the actual useful evidence.
P2.minimal_fix: Derive artificial bubbles from consecutive phase/timestamp events, or remove the vacuous counter and validate exact launch-cycle equations.

P2.finding: All capacity, ready-stall and negative/fault covers are zero. K3/K4 full/partial/no-share covers are not exhaustive partitions and leave 139904/2514920 request cycles unclassified.
P2.minimal_fix: Add closed cover partitions, capacity/stall-directed tests and separately sealed legal and negative protocol campaigns.

P2.finding: Every response weight is signed +1 and every seed accumulator is zero. The run checks add/subtract polarity and 96-lane replication but not arbitrary signed8 values, nonzero seeds or near-overflow accumulation.
P2.minimal_fix: Replay frozen signed extremes, mixed per-bank/lane weights, nonzero seeds and near-boundary accumulators with a full independent lane oracle.

P2.finding: Unexpected response, duplicate context, response mismatch, overflow and sticky-fault covers all have zero matches.
P2.minimal_fix: Add fail-closed VCS attacks for each protocol error with the expected first-failure cause, interface shutdown and sticky-fault behavior.

must_pass: synthesizable online scheduler/address generator rather than offline testbench launches
all10 exact accepted-event and executable-cycle replay
realistic banked-memory latency/backpressure with capacity and fault coverage
M54 core source identity plus exact-SHA DC/STA/Formality/SAIF/PTPX
